data.narrative:
Western Chemicals is a Pre-Seed stage climate & energy company founded by Jared West (Columbia B.S. Physics & Mechanical Engineering, '20) that has raised $175K to date. The valuation universe comprises 1 public comparable (LNZA) and 8 private peers in the climate & energy sector, including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix. However, the narrow peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage datapoints (0 identified meeting filter criteria) to support a reliable peer-median approach.

The analysis therefore relies on stage-progression methodology, which applies a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Pre-Seed to the next funding round. Using the $175K total raised as a proxy for current implied valuation, this method yields $438K. This represents the sole quantifiable triangulation point, establishing a median valuation estimate.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $372K to $503K, centered on $438K. Key uncertainties include the absence of comparable transaction data at the Pre-Seed stage within the climate & energy sector and the limited visibility into Western Chemicals' technical milestones, IP position, and market timing—all material drivers of step-up multiples at early stages. Additional diligence on product-market fit indicators and capital efficiency metrics would refine this estimate as the company progresses toward seed fundraising.
